item.name: Tabby Cat
item.cardSummary: The free starter companion from Clara’s Helping Hand quest. Small luck boost, but it costs no Robux and unlocks the Pets slot early.
item.notes: Complete Clara’s Helping Hand quest at a Pet Store (Fisherman Island or Copper Canyon). Equip from Items → Pets.

item.name: Otter
item.cardSummary: Common Founders Egg hatch that speeds up reeling. Strong early pick if you want faster casts over raw luck.
item.notes: Hatch chance is within the Founders Egg pool. Egg origin only—shop eggs rotate and may not stay listed forever.

item.name: Ferret
item.cardSummary: Arctic Egg rare with the same +18% reel speed template as other Rare pets. Cosmetic variant of the Rare reel-speed role.
item.notes: Published Arctic Egg hatch rates do not sum to 100% across guides, so no hatch percentage is listed. Origin is Arctic Egg only.

item.name: Gecko
item.cardSummary: Kawaii Egg’s common Rare hatch. Same reel-speed buff as other Rares—use it if you rolled Kawaii and need faster reeling.
item.notes: Hatch chance is within the Kawaii Egg pool. Shop eggs rotate; source is origin only.

item.name: Frog
item.cardSummary: Founders Egg Epic built for luck hunting. Big rare-fish odds boost without the auto-catch kit of higher tiers.
item.notes: Hatch chance is within the Founders Egg pool. Egg origin only.

item.name: Cow
item.cardSummary: Founders Egg Epic that favors reel speed over luck. Faster fishing loops if you already have luck from rods or bobbers.
item.notes: Hatch chance is within the Founders Egg pool. Egg origin only.

item.name: Lynx
item.cardSummary: Arctic Egg Epic with the +30% reel-speed Epic template. Same fishing role as Cow or Elephant, different look and origin egg.
item.notes: Published Arctic Egg hatch rates do not sum to 100% across guides, so no hatch percentage is listed.

item.name: Wolf
item.cardSummary: Arctic Egg Epic reel-speed pet. Matches the Epic reel line rather than the Epic luck line.
item.notes: Published Arctic Egg hatch rates do not sum to 100% across guides, so no hatch percentage is listed.

item.name: Tiger
item.cardSummary: Kawaii Egg Epic luck pet. Same +70% luck role as Frog for secret and rare fish odds.
item.notes: Hatch chance is within the Kawaii Egg pool. Egg origin only.

item.name: Elephant
item.cardSummary: Kawaii Egg Epic that boosts reel speed. Prefer it when you want faster casts instead of a pure luck companion.
item.notes: Hatch chance is within the Kawaii Egg pool. Egg origin only.

item.name: Capybara
item.cardSummary: Founders Legendary that mixes modest luck with a slow auto-catch loop. First tier where pets start catching fish for you.
item.notes: Hatch chance is within the Founders Egg pool. Egg origin only.

item.name: Polar Bear
item.cardSummary: Arctic Legendary with the same luck and 65s auto-catch package as Capybara. Cosmetic and origin differ, not the core loop.
item.notes: Published Arctic Egg hatch rates do not sum to 100% across guides, so no hatch percentage is listed.

item.name: Red Panda
item.cardSummary: Kawaii Legendary with the same 65s auto-catch cadence as other Legendaries but a much shorter recharge than Founders/Arctic versions.
item.notes: Hatch chance is within the Kawaii Egg pool. Recharge is tighter than Capybara and Polar Bear on published stats.

item.name: Penguin
item.cardSummary: Founders Mythic with stronger luck and a faster auto-catch cycle than Legendary pets. Solid mid-high companion for AFK-style fishing.
item.notes: Hatch chance is within the Founders Egg pool. Egg origin only.

item.name: Seal
item.cardSummary: Arctic Mythic matching Penguin’s luck and auto-catch timing. Same fishing role as other Mythics, Arctic origin.
item.notes: Published Arctic Egg hatch rates do not sum to 100% across guides, so no hatch percentage is listed.

item.name: Unicorn
item.cardSummary: Kawaii Mythic with Mythic-tier luck and auto-catch, plus a short 1s recharge that edges out Founders and Arctic Mythics on downtime.
item.notes: Hatch chance is within the Kawaii Egg pool. Egg origin only.

item.name: Axolotl
item.cardSummary: Founders Secret with Epic-level luck and a fast auto-catch cycle. Classic top hatch from the launch egg line.
item.notes: Hatch chance is within the Founders Egg pool. Egg origin only.

item.name: Arctic Fox
item.cardSummary: Arctic Egg Secret matching Axolotl’s luck and 22s auto-catch package. Top-tier Arctic companion for rare-fish farming.
item.notes: Published Arctic Egg hatch rates do not sum to 100% across guides, so no hatch percentage is listed.

item.name: Kitsune
item.cardSummary: Kawaii Secret with the highest published luck and the quickest auto-catch interval among hatch pets. Premium luck companion when it drops.
item.notes: Hatch chance is within the Kawaii Egg pool. Lowest published hatch rate among the egg Secrets.

item.name: Ruby Dragon
item.cardSummary: Bundle-only Secret with a flat +50% luck boost and no auto-catch on published stats. Direct purchase path instead of egg hatching.
item.notes: Not an egg hatch. Obtained from the Dragon Bundle (often sold with a rod skin). No hatch percentage applies.
